items.text:
1. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA H (Eligibility only, no signs)
2600 block of Ocean Avenue between Woodacre Drive and 19th Avenue (Supervisor District 7)
(Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Gerry Porras, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility to the residents and occupants of the parcels on
the 2600 block of Ocean Avenue (Except for addresses already in RPP Area H and the parcel facing
Woodacre Drive) so they can purchase parking permits for their vehicle to park within RPP Area H.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
